# House of Happiness — Boutique Aparthotel, Khlong San, Bangkok

> Independent 15-unit serviced-apartment hotel on the Thonburi side of the Chao Phraya River in Khlong San, Bangkok, Thailand. Rated 8.8/10 from 770+ verified guest reviews on Booking.com. Best rates when booking direct.

## Key facts
- Address: 558/1 Tha Din Daeng 16, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand (GPS 13.734137, 100.505014)
- Rooms: Standard double ฿700/night · Studio twin ฿800/night · Deluxe extra-large room with sofa corner ฿850/night
- Policies: minimum stay 2 nights · check-in 14:00–22:00 · check-out 12:00 · ฿1,000 refundable deposit · pay at the hotel (cash, Thai bank transfer, PromptPay) — no online payment required
- Every unit: private city-view balcony, air conditioning, refrigerator, TV, free Wi-Fi, free bottled water; coin laundry on site; no restaurant, no parking
- Nearby: Sampeng Market ~900 m, Chao Phraya Sky Park ~1.3 km, Wat Pho ~1.8 km, Chinatown (Yaowarat) ~2 km, ICONSIAM ~5 min by car, BTS Gold Line Khlong San station
